products.name: Asset Management Services
products.description: Investment management services across credit and equity strategies, including direct origination, asset-backed finance, opportunistic credit, multi-credit, private equity, hybrid value, secondaries, real estate equity, and infrastructure/clean transition equity. Delivered via managed funds, accounts, and vehicles, requiring financial expertise, regulatory compliance, and global investment infrastructure.

products.name: Retirement Savings Products (Annuities and Funding Agreements)
products.description: Issuance, reinsurance, and acquisition of retirement savings products, primarily annuities (fixed rate, indexed, payout, group, and variable) and funding agreements, to individuals and institutions. Requires regulated insurance operations, capital management, and distribution through retail, institutional, and reinsurance channels.

products.name: Reinsurance Solutions
products.description: Reinsurance of insurance and annuity liabilities for third-party insurance companies, including flow and block reinsurance transactions. Delivered through regulated insurance subsidiaries, involving risk transfer, capital management, and underwriting expertise.

products.name: Capital Solutions and Corporate Finance Advisory
products.description: Provision of capital solutions and corporate finance advisory services, including sourcing, structuring, syndicating, and trading loans and private debt, as well as assisting clients and portfolio companies in raising debt and equity capital and optimizing capital structures. Delivered through financial structuring, syndication, and advisory teams.

products.name: Principal Investing
products.description: Direct investments from the company's balance sheet into strategic opportunities, including growth capital and investments to broaden investment management or product distribution capabilities. Involves deployment of proprietary capital and realization of performance fees.

products.name: Drone Components
products.description: Manufactured and sold critical drone components such as motors, headsets, flight controllers, electronic speed controllers (ESCs), batteries, and cameras. These are produced in domestic facilities and delivered to B2B customers, including drone manufacturers and system integrators, with a focus on NDAA-compliant and Blue UAS-listed products.

products.name: Drones (Small Unmanned Aerial Systems)
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells small drones (Group 1 UAS), including FPV and attritable drones, for defense, commercial, and consumer applications. These drones are assembled in domestic facilities and sold through B2B and curated retail channels.

products.name: FPV (First Person View) Systems and Headsets
products.description: Develops and sells integrated FPV systems, including wearable display headsets, onboard cameras, and video transmission modules, enabling immersive drone piloting. These are manufactured and distributed under brands such as Fat Shark and Rotor Riot.

products.name: Drone Accessories
products.description: Produces and sells a range of drone accessories, including batteries, cameras, and other add-ons, supporting both consumer and enterprise drone platforms. Accessories are manufactured in-house or sourced and distributed via retail and B2B channels.

products.name: Retail Drone Sales (E-commerce Platform)
products.description: Operates a curated retail channel, including the Rotor Riot e-commerce platform, selling drones, components, and accessories directly to consumers. Products are distributed online and shipped to end users.

products.name: Containerboard
products.description: Renewable fiber-based containerboard products, including linerboard, medium, whitetop, and saturating kraft, are manufactured in mills and serve as the base material for corrugated packaging. Production requires large-scale physical manufacturing and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Corrugated Packaging
products.description: Corrugated packaging products, such as corrugated boxes, bulk bins, shipping containers, and specialty packaging, are produced by converting containerboard at dedicated facilities. These products are physically manufactured and distributed to industrial, consumer goods, and e-commerce markets.

products.name: Offshore Pipeline Transportation Services
products.description: Transportation and processing of crude oil and natural gas via a network of offshore pipelines and platforms in the Gulf of America, delivered through capital-intensive, regulated and non-regulated infrastructure to energy producers and refiners.

products.name: Marine Transportation Services
products.description: Waterborne transportation of crude oil and petroleum products (primarily fuel oil, asphalt, and other heavy refined products) using a fleet of barges, tankers, and tugboats operating under the U.S. flag throughout North America, serving refineries and storage terminals.

products.name: Onshore Crude Oil and Refined Products Transportation and Services
products.description: Integrated suite of onshore services including terminaling, blending, storing, marketing, and transporting crude oil and refined products via pipelines, trucks, rail, barges, and storage terminals, primarily in the Gulf Coast region.

products.name: Sulfur Removal Services
products.description: Processing of high sulfur (sour) gas streams at refineries and petrochemical facilities to remove sulfur using proprietary technology, returning clean hydrocarbon streams and producing sodium hydrosulfide (NaHS) as a by-product.

products.name: Sodium Hydrosulfide (NaHS) and Caustic Soda (NaOH) Sales
products.description: Production, marketing, and sale of sodium hydrosulfide (NaHS) and caustic soda (NaOH) to industrial and commercial customers, delivered via owned and leased terminals and transportation assets across North and South America.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of loans to businesses, including commercial and industrial loans, SBA loans, specialized lending (such as fund finance, real estate specialty finance, technology and venture capital banking, healthcare, and financial institutions group), mortgage finance, multifamily and commercial real estate lending, and commercial equipment financing. These products are delivered through relationship managers and specialized teams, leveraging both in-person and digital channels.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers residential mortgage loans, home equity loans, and personal installment loans to consumers, including loans originated directly or purchased through fintech partnerships. Delivery is through branches, digital channels, and third-party fintech relationships, with a focus on prime borrowers and conservative underwriting.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Provides a variety of deposit accounts to commercial and consumer customers, including checking, savings, money market, time deposits, and specialized deposit products for businesses. Delivery is through a branch-light physical network and digital banking platforms, with a focus on relationship-based and low-cost core deposits.

products.name: Digital Banking Services
products.description: Delivers digital banking solutions to commercial and consumer customers nationwide, including online and mobile banking, remote account opening, and digital deposit products. These services are provided through proprietary technology platforms and partnerships with fintech companies.

products.name: Payments and Treasury Services
products.description: Provides payments processing, cash management, and treasury services to commercial and institutional clients, including API-based payments, instant B2B payments via the proprietary cubiX platform, and value-added services such as merchant processing, lock box, and account reconciliation. Delivery is primarily digital and technology-driven.

products.name: Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) for Fintech Companies
products.description: Provides banking infrastructure and services to fintech companies, enabling them to offer deposit, lending, and payment products to their end customers. Delivery is through digital platforms and API integrations, leveraging partnerships and proprietary technology.

products.name: Shopping Center Leasing
products.description: Leasing of retail space in shopping centers owned wholly or through joint ventures. This involves physical real estate assets, tenant management, and property operations.

products.name: Office Space Leasing
products.description: Leasing of office space in two adjacent office buildings, with space provided to third-party tenants. This is a physical real estate service involving property management and tenant relations.

products.name: Property Management Services for Joint Ventures
products.description: Management of shopping centers owned through unconsolidated joint ventures, providing operational oversight and property management services. This is a service delivered through in-person management and administrative functions.

products.name: Shared Services to Curbline Properties
products.description: Provision of corporate, leadership, and operational services to Curbline Properties under a Shared Services Agreement, including personnel, office space, and business function support. This is a contractual service involving human capital and administrative resources.

products.name: Casino Gaming
products.description: Operation of large-scale casino gaming facilities offering table games, slot machines, and electronic table games within integrated resorts in Macao and Singapore. Requires regulated infrastructure, significant capital investment, and in-person human labor.

products.name: Hotel Accommodations
products.description: Provision of luxury hotel rooms and suites within integrated resorts, including branded suites and high-end accommodations, produced and delivered through physical hospitality infrastructure and in-person service.

products.name: Retail Mall Leasing
products.description: Ownership and operation of large retail malls within integrated resorts, leasing space to a diverse mix of retail tenants. Revenue is generated primarily from leases, base rents, and reimbursements for common area maintenance.

products.name: Meetings, Incentives, Conventions, and Exhibitions (MICE) Facilities
products.description: Provision of expansive and flexible meeting, convention, and exhibition spaces for business events, trade shows, and conventions, delivered through large-scale, purpose-built facilities and supported by event management services.

products.name: Entertainment and Live Events
products.description: Hosting and production of live entertainment, concerts, sporting events, and shows in dedicated theaters and arenas within integrated resorts, requiring specialized venues and event management.

products.name: Food and Beverage Services
products.description: Operation of a wide range of restaurants, celebrity chef dining, lounges, and food outlets within integrated resorts, delivered through in-person hospitality and culinary teams.

products.name: Ferry Transportation Services
products.description: Operation of ferry services (Cotai Water Jet) providing transportation between Hong Kong and Macao, requiring regulated maritime infrastructure and logistics.

products.name: Performance Apparel
products.description: Branded athletic and activewear apparel engineered with proprietary technologies and technical fabrics, manufactured by third parties and distributed globally through wholesale, direct-to-consumer, and licensing channels.

products.name: Performance Footwear
products.description: Branded athletic and casual footwear designed with advanced cushioning technologies and materials, manufactured by contract manufacturers and distributed globally through wholesale, direct-to-consumer, and licensing channels.

products.name: Performance Accessories
products.description: Branded athletic accessories such as gloves, bags, headwear, and socks, incorporating performance technologies and advanced fabrications, manufactured by third parties and distributed globally through wholesale, direct-to-consumer, and licensing channels.

products.name: Licensed Branded Products
products.description: Licensed Under Armour branded products, including collegiate apparel and accessories, baby and youth apparel, team uniforms, socks, underwear, lunch boxes, coolers, water bottles, eyewear, and other hard goods, developed and sold by licensees under quality and brand standards.

products.name: Infrared Optical Components
products.description: Manufactured using precision molding, diamond turning, and traditional polishing, these components include lenses and elements made from materials such as Germanium, chalcogenide glass (BlackDiamond), silicon, and zinc selenide. They are sold as catalog or custom parts for thermal imaging and other infrared applications.

products.name: Visible Optical Components
products.description: Precision molded aspheric lenses and other visible spectrum optical elements, produced using proprietary glass molding technology for both low and high volume applications. These are used to simplify and enhance optical systems in various industries.

products.name: Optical Assemblies and Modules
products.description: Custom and standard optical assemblies, including lens systems and modules, primarily for infrared applications. These are manufactured using in-house materials and components, and may include complex multi-element designs for integration into customer systems.

products.name: Infrared Camera Systems
products.description: Complete infrared camera systems, including both uncooled and cooled cameras for thermal imaging, surveillance, and detection. These systems are manufactured in-house, leveraging proprietary materials (BlackDiamond) and advanced system integration, and are used in defense, border security, and industrial applications.

products.name: Optical Coating Services
products.description: Provision of advanced optical coatings, including anti-reflective, reflective, protective, and specialty coatings (such as Diamond Like Carbon) for lenses and optical components. These coatings are applied in-house using physical and chemical vapor deposition techniques and are available as a service to external customers.

products.name: Infrared Optical Materials (BlackDiamond Glass)
products.description: Production and sale of proprietary chalcogenide glass materials (BlackDiamond series), which serve as alternatives to Germanium for infrared optics. These materials are manufactured in-house and sold to external customers for use in their own optical systems.

products.name: Engineering and Product Development Services
products.description: Custom engineering and product development services for customers, including design, prototyping, and development of new optical products or applications. These services are often provided under development agreements and may lead to subsequent manufacturing contracts.

products.name: Contemporary Apparel
products.description: Full collections of clothing for men, women, and children, including jeans, pants, skirts, dresses, activewear, shorts, blouses, shirts, jackets, knitwear, outerwear, and intimate apparel. Products are designed in-house and manufactured through global sourcing partners, sold via retail, wholesale, and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Fashion Accessories
products.description: A broad range of accessories including handbags, jewelry, and other fashion items, produced through licensing and direct sourcing, distributed globally via retail, wholesale, and e-commerce.

products.name: Eyewear
products.description: Eyewear products, including sunglasses and optical frames, produced under license agreements and distributed globally through retail, wholesale, and licensed partners.

products.name: Watches
products.description: Fashion watches produced under licensing arrangements, manufactured by third parties and distributed worldwide through retail, wholesale, and licensed channels.

products.name: Footwear
products.description: Footwear for men, women, and children, produced both directly and through licensing partners, distributed globally via retail, wholesale, and e-commerce.

products.name: Fragrance
products.description: Branded fragrances produced under license agreements, manufactured by third parties and distributed globally through retail, wholesale, and licensed channels.

products.name: Children’s and Infants’ Apparel
products.description: Apparel collections specifically for children and infants, designed in-house and produced through global sourcing, sold via dedicated retail stores, wholesale, and e-commerce.

products.name: Licensed Lifestyle Products (rag & bone)
products.description: Lifestyle apparel and accessories under the rag & bone brand, designed and manufactured by Guess under exclusive license, distributed through dedicated retail stores, wholesale, and e-commerce.

products.name: Motion Picture Content Production and Distribution
products.description: Production, acquisition, and global distribution of feature films across theatrical, home entertainment (physical and digital), television, and international markets. Involves physical and digital production, marketing, and licensing to exhibitors, digital platforms, and broadcasters.

products.name: Television Content Production and Distribution
products.description: Development, production, syndication, and global distribution of scripted and unscripted television series, movies, mini-series, and non-fiction programming to broadcast, cable, digital platforms, and syndicators. Delivered via physical and digital means, including licensing and advertising revenue models.

products.name: Global Live Entertainment and Experiences
products.description: Licensing, development, and production of live stage shows, concerts, immersive experiences, and events based on film and television properties. Delivered through in-person events and partnerships with venues and producers worldwide.

products.name: Interactive Entertainment (Games)
products.description: Development and licensing of video games for PC, console, mobile, and virtual reality platforms, based on proprietary film and television content. Delivered digitally and through partnerships with major game publishers and platforms.

products.name: Location-Based Entertainment Attractions
products.description: Licensing and production of branded attractions, theme park experiences, and stand-alone entertainment destinations based on film and television properties. Delivered through physical installations and partnerships with theme parks and venues globally.

products.name: Consumer Products and Merchandise
products.description: Licensing and development of physical and digital merchandise based on film and television properties, sold through e-commerce and retail partners. Involves partnerships with manufacturers and retailers for branded products.

products.name: Music Sales and Licensing
products.description: Management, sales, and licensing of music, songs, scores, and soundtracks from film and television productions. Delivered through digital and physical music platforms, and licensing for broadcast, webcast, and other uses.

products.name: Ancillary Content Licensing
products.description: Licensing of film and television content for non-theatrical venues such as educational institutions, military bases, hotels, and transportation (airlines, ships). Delivered through direct licensing agreements for specialized exhibition.

products.name: Talent Management Services
products.description: Talent representation and management services provided through 3 Arts Entertainment, including commission revenue and executive producer fees for representing creative talent and producing content. Delivered through direct client relationships and production partnerships.

products.name: Fresh Bananas
products.description: Vertically integrated production and global distribution of fresh bananas, sourced from company-owned and leased farms as well as independent growers, delivered through refrigerated shipping and extensive logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Fresh Pineapples
products.description: Production and distribution of fresh pineapples, primarily sourced from company-owned farms in Latin America and Hawaii, delivered globally via refrigerated shipping and supply chain assets.

products.name: Fresh Plantains
products.description: Sourcing and distribution of fresh plantains, primarily from Latin and Central America, using company-owned and partner farms, delivered through global logistics channels.

products.name: Fresh Grapes
products.description: Global export and distribution of fresh grapes, sourced from owned and partner farms, with a focus on export-led, seasonal supply from the southern hemisphere.

products.name: Fresh Avocados
products.description: Sourcing, marketing, and distribution of fresh avocados, sourced globally and locally, with operations spanning production to retail and wholesale channels.

products.name: Fresh Berries
products.description: Sourcing and distribution of fresh berries (including strawberries, blueberries, etc.), supplied from global and local growers, delivered through retail and wholesale channels.

products.name: Fresh Kiwis
products.description: Sourcing and distribution of fresh kiwis, supplied from both local and global growers, with a focus on year-round availability through diversified sourcing.

products.name: Fresh Apples and Pears
products.description: Sourcing and distribution of fresh apples and pears, sourced from owned and partner farms in both hemispheres, delivered through retail and wholesale channels.

products.name: Fresh Cherries
products.description: Export-led sourcing and distribution of fresh cherries, with a strong seasonal focus, particularly from Chile, delivered to global markets.

products.name: Fresh Mangos and Citrus
products.description: Sourcing and distribution of fresh mangos and citrus fruits, sourced globally and delivered through retail, wholesale, and foodservice channels.

products.name: Organic Fresh Produce
products.description: Sourcing and distribution of organic fresh fruits and vegetables, leveraging global grower relationships and delivered through multiple sales channels.

products.name: Diversified Fresh Fruits and Vegetables (EMEA and Americas & ROW)
products.description: Sourcing, marketing, and distribution of a broad portfolio of fresh fruits and vegetables (excluding bananas and pineapples), tailored to local and global markets, delivered through retail, wholesale, foodservice, and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Commercial Cargo and Logistics Services
products.description: Provision of commercial cargo services to third parties, utilizing company-owned refrigerated vessels and logistics infrastructure primarily used for transporting fresh produce.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by investor-owned commercial real estate, including office, industrial, multi-family, retail, hospitality, and construction properties. These loans are physically underwritten, require property inspections, appraisals, and are managed through in-person banking teams.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Origination of loans and lines of credit to businesses, both secured by real estate (owner-occupied) and non-real estate collateral (such as accounts receivable, inventory, equipment). These require financial analysis, collateral evaluation, and are delivered through relationship managers and loan officers.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Lending (Legacy Portfolio and Outsourced Origination)
products.description: Management of a portfolio of residential mortgage loans (including single family, owner-occupied, second homes, and construction loans) originated prior to October 2025, and provision of residential mortgage origination to customers via a strategic partnership with a national mortgage banking company. Loans are physically underwritten and serviced, with some sold to third parties.

products.name: Consumer Lending (Home Equity, Student, and Other Consumer Loans)
products.description: Origination and servicing of home equity loans and lines of credit, student loans, and other consumer loans (now discontinued for new originations). These are physically underwritten, secured by real estate or other collateral, and managed through branch and digital channels.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provision of a variety of deposit accounts to retail, business, and government customers, including checking, savings, money market, and time deposits. Delivered through physical branches and digital channels, supported by regulated banking infrastructure.

products.name: Bankcard Services
products.description: Provision of debit card and related payment services to customers, including transaction processing and interchange fee generation. Delivered via digital and physical card infrastructure, regulated by payment networks and banking laws.

products.name: Trust and Fiduciary Services
products.description: Provision of trust and fiduciary services to customers, including estate administration, investment management, and related services. Delivered by specialized personnel and subject to regulatory oversight.

products.name: Mortgage Banking (Loan Sales and Servicing)
products.description: Sale of originated residential mortgage loans to third parties and government-sponsored enterprises, and servicing of mortgage loans for others. Involves digital and physical loan processing, compliance, and servicing infrastructure.

products.name: Interest Rate Swap Program for Commercial Loans
products.description: Provision of interest rate swap arrangements to commercial loan customers, allowing conversion of adjustable-rate loans to fixed-rate. The Bank simultaneously offsets risk by selling swaps to investment-grade counterparties. Delivered via financial markets infrastructure and specialized staff.

products.name: Haduvio (oral nalbuphine ER)
products.description: An oral extended-release formulation of nalbuphine, a small molecule opioid mixed agonist-antagonist, developed and manufactured via established, scalable processes and delivered as oral tablets. Haduvio is intended for the treatment of chronic cough associated with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), non-IPF interstitial lung disease (ILD), and refractory chronic cough (RCC).

products.name: Postsecondary Degree Programs
products.description: Accredited associate, bachelor's, master's, and doctoral degree programs delivered online, on-campus, and in hybrid formats across disciplines such as business, information technology, health sciences, nursing, engineering, education, behavioral sciences, and criminal justice. Programs are developed and delivered by faculty and utilize proprietary and third-party learning management systems and personalized learning technologies.

products.name: Graduate Health Sciences Programs
products.description: Graduate-level degree programs in health sciences, including physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech-language pathology, and nursing, delivered through a combination of classroom, clinical, and distance education with a strong hands-on clinical component. These programs are primarily offered by the University of St. Augustine for Health Sciences.

products.name: Non-Degree and Professional Development Programs
products.description: Online non-degree courses and bootcamps focused on upskilling and reskilling, providing targeted knowledge and skills in specific areas for career advancement or personal interest. Delivered digitally and designed for flexibility for working adults.

products.name: Continuing Education Programs for Healthcare Professionals
products.description: Continuing education courses for licensed healthcare practitioners, primarily in physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech-language pathology, and nursing, delivered online and in-person to support ongoing professional licensure and skill development.

products.name: Electric Distribution Services
products.description: Local distribution of electricity to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in New Hampshire and Massachusetts, delivered via regulated utility infrastructure owned and operated by Unitil subsidiaries.

products.name: Natural Gas Distribution Services
products.description: Local distribution of natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in New Hampshire, Massachusetts, and Maine, using regulated utility pipelines and infrastructure operated by Unitil subsidiaries.

products.name: Interstate Natural Gas Transmission Services
products.description: Transportation of natural gas via interstate transmission pipelines, primarily serving Unitil’s own distribution utilities and third-party suppliers, regulated by FERC and operated by Granite State Gas Transmission, Inc.

products.name: Senior Secured Loans
products.description: Origination and investment in senior secured loans, including first lien and second lien facilities, to privately held, lower middle market companies in the United States. These loans are typically based on a floating interest rate index and have a term of three to six years. The company generates income through interest payments, origination and other fees, and may receive warrants to purchase common stock in connection with these loans.

products.name: Mezzanine Loans and Subordinated Debt
products.description: Opportunistic investments in mezzanine loans or other forms of subordinated debt to companies, typically as part of a broader capital structure solution. These investments are made when they present an opportunity for attractive risk-adjusted returns and may include additional features such as warrants.

products.name: Equity Investments and Warrants
products.description: Equity investments, including direct equity interests and warrants to purchase common stock, typically received in connection with debt investments. These are generally minority positions and are intended to provide capital appreciation alongside debt returns.

products.name: Managerial Assistance to Portfolio Companies
products.description: Provision of significant managerial assistance, including guidance and counsel concerning management, operations, or business objectives, to portfolio companies that request such assistance. This service is typically provided through WhiteHorse Administration and may generate fees or cost reimbursements.

products.name: Human Capital Management (HCM) Solutions
products.description: A suite of cloud-based applications for managing the entire employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, payroll, development, retention, and reskilling, delivered as a unified digital platform with embedded AI capabilities.

products.name: Financial Management Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based applications for managing core financial processes such as payables, receivables, financial consolidation, and compliance, with AI-powered tools for real-time insights, forecasting, and process automation, delivered digitally via the Workday platform.

products.name: Spend Management Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based solutions for procurement and expense management, supporting the source-to-contract process, supplier selection, contract management, and expense reporting, with analytics and controls for spend optimization.

products.name: Enterprise Planning Solutions
products.description: Active planning and modeling tools for finance, workforce, sales, and operations, enabling scenario modeling, forecasting, and real-time data-driven decision-making, delivered as a digital SaaS solution integrated with HCM and Financial Management.

products.name: Industry-Specific Solutions
products.description: Tailored cloud-based applications and modules addressing unique needs of industries such as healthcare (supply chain, inventory), higher education (student/faculty lifecycle), and government, delivered via the Workday platform and partner ecosystem.

products.name: Workday Platform and Developer Tools
products.description: An open, extensible cloud platform enabling customers and partners to build, deploy, and integrate custom applications and AI agents, including low-code tools (e.g., Workday Build, Flowise Agent Builder) and APIs, delivered as a digital service.

products.name: Workday Data Cloud
products.description: A cloud-based data service providing secure, bidirectional, zero-copy access to HCM and finance data, enabling integration with analytics platforms and operational systems, and supporting data sharing and analysis across organizations.

products.name: Professional Services
products.description: Deployment, consulting, and ongoing adoption services provided by Workday and its partners to help customers implement, optimize, and expand use of Workday solutions, delivered through human expertise and digital tools.

products.name: Customer Success and Support Services
products.description: Subscription-based support, training, and advisory services, including 24/7 support, on-demand education, and strategic guidance, designed to enhance customer experience and maximize value from Workday solutions.

products.name: Cannabis Banking Compliance Platform
products.description: A proprietary technology and service platform enabling financial institutions to provide compliant banking services to cannabis-related businesses (CRBs), including onboarding, due diligence, transaction monitoring, and regulatory reporting. Delivered as a combination of software and managed compliance services, not as a standalone SaaS product.

products.name: Cannabis-Related Deposit Services
products.description: Origination, onboarding, verification, and servicing of deposit accounts for CRBs on behalf of partner financial institutions, including business checking, savings, cash management, ACH, wire, and remote deposit services. The company does not hold deposits but manages the compliance and operational aspects for financial institutions.

products.name: Commercial Lending Services for Cannabis Businesses
products.description: Sourcing, underwriting, servicing, and administering loans to cannabis businesses and related entities, primarily funded through partner financial institutions and private capital sources. Includes senior secured and unsecured loans, with collateral such as real estate and equipment. The company earns a share of loan program income but does not hold loans on its balance sheet.

products.name: On-Site Due Diligence and Compliance Review Services
products.description: Professional advisory and technology services, including on-site due diligence reviews and compliance inspections for cannabis-friendly financial institutions and CRBs. These services were expanded through the acquisition of 420 IT Solutions and are delivered by specialized teams at client locations.

products.name: Managed Services for Cannabis Businesses and Financial Institutions
products.description: Outsourced consulting and operational support services, including finance, accounting, treasury, information technology, and human resources, provided directly to CRBs and financial institutions. These services are delivered by company personnel and are intended to supplement clients' internal infrastructure.

products.name: Merchant Services (ATM and Payment Processing)
products.description: Provision of merchant services, including shared fees for the use of automated teller machines (ATMs) and payment processing solutions for CRBs. These services are delivered in partnership with financial institutions and third-party providers.

products.name: Commercial Drone Solutions
products.description: Distribution and integration of unmanned aerial systems (UAS) hardware, including drones, payloads, sensors, batteries, and accessories, as well as related services such as training, certification, repair, maintenance, fleet management, compliance support, and financing. Delivered through wholesale, direct sales, retail showroom, and e-commerce channels to enterprise, government, and consumer customers. Relies on physical inventory, technical expertise, and service infrastructure.

products.name: Unmanned Platforms for Defense and Commercial Applications
products.description: Design, development, and production of advanced unmanned aerial platforms, with a focus on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and airframe engineering for defense and commercial customers. Delivered through internal R&D, strategic partnerships, and co-development arrangements. Requires significant engineering, manufacturing, and compliance with defense procurement standards.

products.name: Domestic Manufacturing of UAS Platforms and Components
products.description: Development and scaling of U.S.-based manufacturing capabilities for unmanned systems, components, and related technologies, targeting demand for domestically produced, NDAA-compliant UAS platforms and components. Delivered through manufacturing partnerships, joint ventures, and investments in domestic production capacity. Involves regulated infrastructure and compliance with federal procurement requirements.

products.name: Precision Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: Small molecule drugs for cancer treatment, including ACR-368 (CHK1/2 inhibitor), ACR-2316 (dual WEE1/PKMYT1 inhibitor), and ACR-6840 (CDK11 inhibitor), discovered or developed using proprietary proteomics-based AP3 platform. These are physically manufactured pharmaceuticals delivered to patients via clinical and, if approved, commercial channels.

products.name: OncoSignature Companion Diagnostic Tests
products.description: Proprietary, drug-tailored, automated, quantitative proteomic tissue imaging tests (OncoSignature) applied to pretreatment tumor biopsies as companion diagnostics to select patients most likely to benefit from specific oncology therapeutics. These are laboratory-developed tests performed in a CLIA-certified lab and may be commercialized alongside therapeutics.

products.name: AP3 Precision Medicine Platform Services
products.description: Proprietary Generative Phosphoproteomics AP3 platform services for drug discovery, optimization, indication finding, and biomarker identification. Delivered as a suite of digital and laboratory-based services, potentially offered to partners for co-development or licensing.

products.name: Fundraising and Engagement Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based AI-powered software for fundraising, donor relationship management, peer-to-peer fundraising, event management, and online giving, delivered as integrated platforms for nonprofits and social impact organizations.

products.name: Financial Management Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based fund accounting, billing, tuition management, and financial aid management software for nonprofits and educational institutions, integrating payment processing and reporting tools.

products.name: Grant and Award Management Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based software for managing the end-to-end grantmaking and scholarship award processes, including application, review, compliance, and reporting for foundations, nonprofits, and educational institutions.

products.name: Education Management Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based student information, learning management, enrollment, and school website systems for K-12 and higher education institutions, supporting academic records, admissions, and communications.

products.name: Social Responsibility and Employee Engagement Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based platforms for corporate social responsibility, employee giving, volunteering, and impact reporting, enabling companies to manage philanthropy, grants, and employee engagement programs.

products.name: Payment Processing Services
products.description: Integrated payment processing services for donations, tuition, and other transactions, supporting credit card and ACH payments with PCI compliance, embedded within Blackbaud's software solutions.

products.name: Data Intelligence and Analytics Services
products.description: AI-powered data intelligence, predictive insights, data health, and fundraising performance analytics, delivered as integrated services or add-ons to core software platforms for decision support and campaign optimization.

products.name: Professional and Managed Services
products.description: Consulting, implementation, optimization, data conversion, customization, and outcome-based services to support deployment and effective use of Blackbaud's software solutions, delivered by in-house experts and partners.

products.name: Training Services
products.description: Product training and enablement services, including online and in-person courses, to help customers maximize the value and effective use of Blackbaud's solutions.

products.name: Fashion Footwear
products.description: Designs, sources, and markets a wide range of branded and private label footwear, including dress shoes, boots, booties, fashion sneakers, sandals, and casual shoes, distributed through wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels. Products are manufactured overseas and sold globally via retail stores, e-commerce, and wholesale partners.

products.name: Handbags and Accessories
products.description: Designs, sources, and markets branded and private label handbags, small leather goods, belts, soft accessories, fashion scarves, wraps, gifting, and other trend accessories, distributed through wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels. Products are manufactured overseas and sold globally via retail stores, e-commerce, and wholesale partners.

products.name: Apparel
products.description: Designs, sources, and markets branded and private label apparel, including elevated basics such as t-shirts and other clothing, distributed through wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels. Products are manufactured overseas and sold globally via retail stores, e-commerce, and wholesale partners.

products.name: Brand Licensing
products.description: Licenses company-owned trademarks (such as Steve Madden, Kurt Geiger, and Betsey Johnson) to third parties for use in select apparel, accessories, home categories, and other non-core products, generating royalty revenue. Licensing agreements are global and cover a variety of product categories beyond the company’s core offerings.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Origination of commercial business loans, including term loans and lines of credit, typically secured by business equipment, accounts receivable, inventory, or other property. These loans are structured and managed by in-person bankers and require significant financial capital and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial real estate properties such as office buildings, warehouses, retail centers, assisted living, and single-purpose facilities. These loans are physically underwritten, require property collateral, and are managed by in-person bankers under regulatory standards.

products.name: Multi-Family Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by multi-family residential properties. These loans are physically underwritten, require property collateral, and are managed by in-person bankers under regulatory standards.

products.name: Land and Real Estate Construction Lending
products.description: Origination of loans for land acquisition, development, and construction of residential and commercial properties, including speculative, custom/presold, and construction/permanent loans. These require physical property collateral, in-person underwriting, and ongoing project monitoring.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Origination of consumer loans, including residential one-to-four family mortgages, home equity lines of credit, installment loans (auto, boat, debt consolidation), and other secured and unsecured loans. These are physically underwritten and require regulatory compliance.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provision of deposit accounts to consumers and businesses, including demand deposits, NOW accounts, money market accounts, savings accounts, certificates of deposit, and retirement savings plans. Delivered through physical branches and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Trust and Asset Management Services
products.description: Provision of trust, estate planning, and asset management services, including fiduciary and investment management, through the Trust Company subsidiary. Delivered by specialized professionals and supported by regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Mortgage Brokerage Services
products.description: Origination and brokering of mortgage loans (including construction loans) for various mortgage companies, earning fees for facilitating these transactions. Delivered by commissioned brokers and digital/physical processes.

products.name: Investment Securities Portfolio Management
products.description: Management and sale of investment securities, including agency securities, municipal bonds, mortgage-backed securities, and REMICs. Primarily for balance sheet management, but may include sales to external customers or institutional investors.

products.name: Traditional Banking Services
products.description: A full suite of deposit and lending products, including checking and savings accounts, debit cards, electronic banking, and treasury management, delivered through a branch network and digital channels. Requires regulated infrastructure, in-person and digital service, and financial capital.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: A range of loans to businesses, including commercial real estate, construction, equipment, agriculture, asset-based, and general commercial loans, originated both locally and nationwide. Delivered through in-person relationship management and digital channels, requiring significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Personal loans and residential real estate loans (first and second mortgages) for individual customers, primarily in community banking markets. Delivered through branch network and digital channels, requiring financial capital and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Mortgage Warehouse Lending
products.description: Short-term lending facilities to mortgage originators, allowing them to fund residential mortgage loans until sold to investors. Requires specialized financial capital management and regulatory compliance, delivered nationwide.

products.name: Factoring Services
products.description: Purchase of accounts receivable (primarily transportation invoices) from clients at a discount to provide immediate working capital, with specialized risk management and automated underwriting. Delivered via proprietary digital platforms and in-person service, requiring financial capital and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Factoring as a Service (FaaS)
products.description: Provision of back-office factoring services and technology to third parties in the transportation industry, enabling them to supplement or offer factoring services using Triumph's platform. Delivered digitally and via service teams.

products.name: Payments Platform for Trucking Industry
products.description: A digital payments network connecting Brokers, Shippers, Factors, and Carriers to manage, audit, and settle transportation invoices, including quick pay and supply chain finance solutions. Delivered via proprietary software and digital accounts, requiring regulated infrastructure and technology.

products.name: LoadPay Digital Bank Account
products.description: A digital bank account and financial product suite tailored for small trucking companies, enabling rapid funding of invoices and small business transactional accounts. Delivered digitally, leveraging proprietary payment rails.

products.name: Supply Chain Finance for Brokers
products.description: Financing solutions for Brokers to pay Carriers faster, improving liquidity and Carrier loyalty. Delivered through the payments platform, requiring financial capital and digital infrastructure.

products.name: Data Intelligence and Analytics Services
products.description: Data-driven insights, benchmarking, performance scoring, and pricing intelligence for logistics and trucking industry participants, leveraging proprietary data from payments and factoring operations. Delivered digitally via acquired and proprietary platforms.

products.name: Insurance Brokerage Services
products.description: Insurance brokerage focused on meeting the insurance needs of commercial finance clients, particularly in transportation and equipment lending. Delivered through Triumph Insurance Group, requiring licensed professionals and regulatory compliance.

products.name: News and Business Information Services
products.description: Provision of news, analysis, commentary, and business information to consumers and enterprises via digital platforms (websites, mobile apps, podcasts, video) and print publications. Includes flagship brands such as The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, MarketWatch, Investor’s Business Daily, and related digital networks. Delivered through proprietary digital infrastructure and physical print operations.

products.name: Professional Information and Compliance Data Services
products.description: Delivery of specialized data, analytics, and compliance solutions for enterprise customers, including risk and compliance screening, energy pricing data, business content archives, and real-time newswires. Products include Dow Jones Risk & Compliance, Dow Jones Energy, Factiva, and Dow Jones Newswires, distributed digitally and via integration with client systems.

products.name: Digital Real Estate Listing and Advertising Services
products.description: Online platforms for property and property-related advertising, lead generation, and real estate information, primarily through realestate.com.au, realcommercial.com.au, Flatmates.com.au, and Realtor.com®. Services are delivered digitally via websites and mobile apps, with revenue from listing products, advertising subscriptions, and referral-based services.

products.name: Mortgage Broking and Financial Services
products.description: Provision of digital mortgage broking and related financial services, including property search and financing experiences, primarily under the Mortgage Choice brand. Services are delivered digitally and through in-person broker networks, generating revenue from lender commissions.

products.name: Book Publishing (Print and Digital)
products.description: Publishing and global distribution of consumer books in print, e-book, and audiobook formats under the HarperCollins brand and its imprints. Involves physical manufacturing, digital content production, and licensing to retailers and technology platforms.

products.name: Print and Digital News Media
products.description: Production and distribution of newspapers, magazines, and digital news content through brands such as News Corp Australia, News UK, and New York Post. Delivered via print, websites, mobile apps, and digital networks, with revenue from subscriptions, circulation, and advertising.

products.name: Radio Broadcasting and Streaming Audio Services
products.description: Operation of radio stations and digital streaming audio channels, including talkSPORT, Virgin Radio, and Talk in the U.K., as well as Sky News Australia. Delivered via regulated broadcast infrastructure and digital streaming platforms, generating revenue from advertising and sponsorships.

products.name: Social Media Content Agency Services
products.description: Provision of real-time video content sourcing and verification for media clients through Storyful, leveraging digital platforms and social media monitoring technologies.

products.name: Next-Generation Protein Sequencing (NGPS) Platforms (Platinum, Platinum Pro, Proteus)
products.description: Integrated instruments for single-molecule, amino acid-level protein sequencing, featuring proprietary detection technology, automated workflows, and scalable throughput. These platforms are physically manufactured and delivered to research laboratories for proteomics analysis.

products.name: Sequencing Consumables (Library Preparation Kits, Barcoding Kits, Sequencing Kits, Consumable Chips)
products.description: Proprietary reagent kits and semiconductor consumable chips required to prepare samples and perform sequencing runs on NGPS instruments. These are manufactured physical products sold on a recurring basis for use with the company's platforms.

products.name: Platinum Analysis Software
products.description: Cloud-based and on-instrument software suite that automates data analysis workflows, provides visualization tools, and supports peptide mapping, protein inference, and variant calling for sequencing results. Delivered digitally or embedded in instruments.

products.name: MOSFETs
products.description: Manufactured semiconductor devices functioning as solid state switches for power control, conversion, and management, produced via advanced wafer fabrication and packaging processes in global facilities.

products.name: Diodes and Power Modules
products.description: Manufactured semiconductor components including rectifiers, small signal diodes, protection diodes, thyristors/SCRs, and power modules, used for routing, regulating, and blocking signals, as well as surge protection and power conversion, produced in high-volume global manufacturing operations.

products.name: Optoelectronic Components
products.description: Manufactured components that emit, detect, or transmit light, including IR emitters and detectors, IR remote control receivers, optocouplers, solid-state relays, optical sensors, LEDs, and display modules, produced using semiconductor and packaging technologies in global facilities.

products.name: Resistors
products.description: Manufactured passive electronic components that impede electric current, including fixed, variable, and non-linear resistors, produced from various materials and forms for use in all types of electronic circuitry, with specialty and commodity offerings.

products.name: Inductors
products.description: Manufactured passive components that use magnetic fields to change AC phase and resist AC, including low-profile, high-current inductors and custom magnetic solutions, produced for specialized and high-reliability applications in global facilities.

products.name: Capacitors
products.description: Manufactured passive components that store and discharge energy, including tantalum, ceramic, film, power, and aluminum electrolytic capacitors, produced in a range of sizes and technologies for applications from mobile devices to power grids.

products.name: PhotoStress Products and Strain Gages
products.description: Specialized products including PhotoStress coatings and instruments for measuring stress distribution, and foil resistance strain gages for structural analysis, produced using proprietary materials and manufacturing processes.

products.name: Zetomipzomib
products.description: A first-in-class, selective immunoproteasome inhibitor small molecule therapeutic developed for the treatment of severe autoimmune and immune-mediated diseases. It is manufactured via third-party contract manufacturing organizations as a lyophilized product for subcutaneous, once-weekly self-administration, pending regulatory approval.

products.name: Ownership and Leasing of Open-Air, Grocery-Anchored Shopping Centers
products.description: The company owns, operates, acquires, develops, redevelops, and leases high-quality, open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers and mixed-use assets, primarily in high-growth Sun Belt and select gateway markets in the U.S. Revenue is generated through contractual rents and reimbursement payments from tenants under lease agreements. This business requires significant real estate investment, property management, and leasing expertise.

products.name: Ownership and Leasing of Mixed-Use Properties with Office Components
products.description: The company owns and leases mixed-use properties that include office space components, in addition to retail. These properties are managed and leased to external tenants, generating rental income. This business line involves property management and leasing of both retail and office spaces within mixed-use developments.

products.name: Development and Redevelopment of Retail and Mixed-Use Properties
products.description: The company engages in the development and redevelopment of retail and mixed-use properties, including ground-up construction and major renovations to enhance property value and attract tenants. This involves real estate development, construction management, and capital investment, with revenue generated from leasing newly developed or redeveloped spaces.
